stories.title: Australian PGA Round 3 — Von Dellingshausen at 16-Under, Three Clear

x_posts.label: Post 1A
x_posts.text:
**Window:** 8:00 AM ET
**Character count:** 207

Nicolai Von Dellingshausen leads the BMW Australian PGA Championship at 16-under after R3 at The Lakes in Sydney. Noren is second at 13-under. McKibbin and Aphibarnrat tied at 12-under. Final round Sunday. #GolfAustralia

x_posts.label: Post 1B
x_posts.text:
**Window:** 8:30 PM ET
**Character count:** 194

Final round Sunday at the Australian PGA. Von Dellingshausen leads by 3 at 16-under. Can Noren, McKibbin or Aphibarnrat close the gap? Amateur Barron is still inside the top 5. #GolfAustralia
